newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-McGrath to return home through injury.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-McGrath to return home through injury.

text.p: Australia fast bowler Glenn McGrath will miss the upcoming limited overs series against South Africa after succumbing to a nagging foot injury, the Australian Cricket Board (ACB) said on Tuesday.
Queensland pace bowler Adam Dale will be sent to South Africa as a replacement for the seven-match series over the coming three weeks.
Western Australia wicketkeeper Adam Gilchrist will join Dale on the plane to South Africa as cover for Ian Healy, who was suspended from the first two one-day internationals for dissent.
Both Gilchrist and Dale are playing for their respective states in the domestic Sheffield Shield final, which will conclude at Perth's WACA Ground on Tuesday.
McGrath, who has been troubled by the foot injury for the past week, will leave for home on Thursday, an ACB spokeswoman told Reuters.
Vice-captain Healy was banned after being found guilty of dissent during the third and final test, won convincingly by South Africa at Centurion Park in Pretoria on Monday.
Healy glowered angrily with hand on hip at umpire Cyril Mitchley after he was given out and stamped from the field before throwing his bat into the dressing-room.
He will miss the matches in East London on Saturday and Port Elizabeth on Monday.
Australia, who won the test series 2-1, have already made three changes for the limited overs fixtures, calling up all-rounders Stuart Law and Michael DiVenuto and left-arm seamer Brendon Julian.
They will replace specialist batsmen Matthew Hayden, Matthew Elliott and Justin Langer.
